BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   D. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

4. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   C. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   D. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   B. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Money as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money.

12. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Business Transactions 4.2 Effects of Business Transactions 4.3 Source Documents  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Business Transactions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Effects of Business Transactions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Source Documents and Journals Page 14 of 55 1 STRAND 1.0: BUSINESS AND MONEY MAN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
